title: The Fish That Was Prepared
old_p1: The wind and waves were very big. Jonah knew it was happening because he had run from Heavenly Father. So he told the sailors the truth: “Put me in the sea, and it will be calm.”
The sailors did not want to. They rowed hard to get back to land, but the wind was too strong.
old_p2: At last they put Jonah into the sea, and the sea grew still. The sailors made promises to Heavenly Father.
Heavenly Father had already prepared a great fish. It swallowed Jonah, and he stayed safe inside for three days and three nights. Jesus later said this was a sign about Him.
Heavenly Father makes safe places for the people He loves. Feel your soft, safe bed tonight. You are one of His people too.
p1: The wind blew hard. Jonah knew the storm came because he ran away. He told the sailors, “Put me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm.”
The sailors did not want to. They rowed and rowed to get back to land. But the waves were too strong.
At last, they put Jonah into the sea. Then the sea became calm and still.
p2: But Heavenly Father had prepared a great fish, ready and waiting. The fish swallowed Jonah. Jonah stayed safe inside for three days and three nights. Long after, Jesus said Jonah’s three days were a sign pointing to Him.
Heavenly Father kept Jonah safe. He takes care of you too. Tonight you can snuggle in and feel His love.
